name: Question 4
worked_solution:
The given repeating decimal can be expressed as

$$
\begin{aligned}0.\overset{―}{9} & =0.999… \\  & =0.9+0.09+0.009+… \\  & =\frac{9}{10}+\frac{9}{100}+\frac{9}{1\,000}+⋯.\end{aligned}
$$

We see that we have a geometric series with first term ${a}_{1}=\frac{9}{10}$ and common ratio $r=\frac{1}{10}.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}0.\overset{―}{9} & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{1}{r}^{n-1} \\  & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{9}{10}{(\frac{1}{10})}^{n-1} \\  & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }9(\frac{1}{10}){(\frac{1}{10})}^{n-1} \\  & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }9{(\frac{1}{10})}^{n}.\end{aligned}
$$
